name: Organic ambient pluck-pad with ladder, velocity, chorus-space
goal: Shape a soft sine-based ambient pluck that sustains as a pad: warp toward saw, ladder filter envelope, gentle distortion, pink-noise bed, pitch drift, velocity→level/cutoff, then chorus pushed toward long decay plus reverb/delay.

source.title: Making Dreamy & Organic Pads | Vital Sound Design Tutorial

prerequisites: Wavetable/VA synth with warp/squeeze, dual filters, distortion FX, chorus, delay, reverb, velocity mod

inputs.name: pluck_vs_pad_sustain
inputs.description: Sustain level high enough to hold as pad

inputs.name: filter_model
inputs.description: Ladder/analog for smooth vs dirty/digital for grit

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.
Use distortion mainly for harmonics; post-filter/blend to avoid loudness jumps when raising drive mix.
Chorus-as-infinite-reverb can mud — high-pass / envelope the spread and add a real reverb carefully.

steps.action: Init patch. Amp env: short attack, raised decay, mid sustain (not zero), some release so held notes act as pads.
steps.expect: Works as pluck and held pad

steps.action: Osc: soft sine/basic shape; apply warp/squeeze toward a saw–sine hybrid for mild harmonics.
Filter1 ladder (or analog): env2 pluck contour → cutoff (~+24 semitones depth); low resonance; key track on; drive near zero for subtlety.
steps.expect: Organic pluck contour without harsh resonance

steps.action: FX distortion (e.g. sine-fold): moderate drive, reduced mix; enable post-filter with high cutoff/low resonance/blend to control level vs harmonics.
Low pink noise → band-pass filter2 with drive, key track, low resonance so noise blends and stays mid-focused.
steps.expect: Analog-like air without bright hiss or rumble

steps.action: Add slow pitch drift; optional formant/warp random (stereo, ~2s) bipolar for organic movement.
Velocity → osc level and warp/squeeze and cutoff so soft plays are darker/quieter.

Chorus: freeze/tempo off, raise depth/delay, high feedback for long decay; high-pass; envelope → spread for note-ducked lush tails; then real reverb (~80 size, ~30% mix, low cut) and dotted-quarter delay (~30% mix).

verification: Held notes sustain as a pad
Time FX don’t bury the dry transient entirely
